description: Execution details for an interactive session task. Set by Synapse as the session starts, runs and ends; a status update cannot change them.

sessionId.description: The ID of the running session, issued by the session launcher.

workspaceId.description: The ID of the /workspace the session mounted: the ID of the task that owns the workspace.

endsOn.description: When the session is ended automatically.

inputFiles.description: The files copied into the session's /inputs, recorded for the audit trail.

outputFiles.description: The files the session wrote to /outputs, waiting for review.

outputFolderId.description: The Synapse ID of the Folder that holds the approved outputs. Set when the outputs are approved; chained tasks read their inputs from it.
